title: QA Automation Tester
description:
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  

We are currently seeking a QA Automation Tester to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN\-UP), India (IN).
  
  

QE\- Automation \-
  
  

**Key responsibilities include:**  

* Overall Experience of 6\+ years in Automation Testing.
* Strong experience with Test Automation using BDD/Cucumber
* Skilled with API Test Automation
* Experienced with Front End Test Automation using Selenium
* Integrate automated tests into the continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines to enable frequent and reliable releases.
* Evaluate requirements and define testing objectives and approaches while working in a global Agile Scrum team.
* Proactively seek opportunities to form partnerships with the customers and stakeholders to co\-create value for the company.
* Ensure the Test Conditions and Expected Results are complete and accurate.
* Demonstrable experience in tracking fixes and features in JIRA or similar configuration management tool.


Perform day\-to\-day automated functional testing activities to ensure that the current commitments are achieved while improvements are being made.
  
  

**Key Qualifications and Skills:**  

* Strong experience with Test Automation using BDD/Cucumber
* Experience with API Test Automation using Rest Assured, Swagger etc.
* Experienced with Front End Test Automation using Selenium
* Experience with creation and maintenance of Automation Framework
* Skilled in scripting/good knowledge and understanding with one of the following programming languages: Java, Java Script, Python etc.
* Good SQL knowledge.
* Experienced with Github/Gitlab
* Expertise in test planning, writing test cases/scripts
* Come up with test strategies and test plans for new and existing features
* Solid understanding and experience with agile software development methodologies and the practices derived from it.
* Derive test conditions and expected results from requirements user stories.


**QA:**  

Automation \- Playwright,
  
SQL
  
Experience testing APIs, microservices, web applications, data pipelines, and enterprise platforms.
  
Testing React JS applications
  
CI/CD, Dev ops \- test integrations
  
Understanding of AI/ML testing concepts
  
should be able to write edge cases (negative, break cases)
